name: hamilton-harness

tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Everything about the rep at a glance: persona, scope, look, handoff rules, policy rules, the actions it can take, the record types it can take down, the names of its knowledge files, and recent activity counts.

tools.name: update_settings
tools.description: Change some fields in one section and keep the rest. Sections: persona (name, company, role, voice, banned_phrases, disclosure), scope (covers, off_topic_reply, refuse, strict, ground_numbers), widget (greeting, accent, theme, title, suggestions, corners, font), handoff (phrases, on_request, message). Call get_overview for current values.

tools.name: read_knowledge
tools.description: Read one knowledge file, such as shipping.md.

tools.name: write_knowledge
tools.description: Create or replace a knowledge file. Use Markdown with clear headings: each heading becomes a section the rep can look up on its own.

tools.name: delete_knowledge
tools.description: Delete a knowledge file. The rep stops stating anything only that file held.

tools.name: save_rules
tools.description: Replace the full list of policy rules. Read the current list from get_overview first, change what is needed, and send the whole list back.

tools.name: run_fake_customers
tools.description: Run the pack's test customers against the current configuration and return the scorecard. Run this after any change to rules, scope or knowledge.

tools.name: list_records
tools.description: Orders, quotation requests and other records the rep has taken down for the business, newest first. Pass a type such as "order" or "quote" to filter.

tools.name: set_record_status
tools.description: Mark a record new, confirmed, done or cancelled.

tools.name: recent_conversations
tools.description: Recent real conversations, newest first, flagged where the guard stepped in, a message was off topic, or a human took over.

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.description: Every recorded step of one conversation, to see why the rep answered as it did.

instructions:
This server manages one company's AI rep on a Hamilton server: who the rep
is, what it knows, what it may promise, the orders and quotes it has taken, and when a human
takes over.

Start with get_overview. Knowledge files are the facts the rep answers from; anything not in them
is something the rep should not state, so add facts there rather than to the persona. After
changing rules, scope or knowledge, call run_fake_customers and report the result: it shows
whether the rep still refuses what it should. Edits are validated; if one is refused, the message
says which field was wrong.
